_comment: Real Moscow administrative district (район) boundaries, one Feature per office district row (matched by normalized name). Source: OSM/HFLabs-derived municipal boundaries mirrored at github.com/Hasarol/moscow_districts (mo.geojson), filtered to our 125 districts and re-keyed to our 'name'. Coordinates EPSG:4326 (lng,lat), rounded to 6 decimals (~0.1m). The 5 non-district demand hubs (rail stations Белорусская/Павелецкая/Курская, airports Шереметьевская/Домодедово) have no admin boundary and keep their placeholder squares.
